_what: The opening cover (thread-cover.mjs): what it says and how it moves, as DATA. quotes: one is shown each time Trillion opens, never the one shown last time on this device. timing_ms: how long each part of the thread's loop lasts (the needle drawing thread all over, pulling it in until it bunches into a ball, the ball held, pulled straight, resting straight) and how long the cover takes to dissolve away. look: the landing page's paper, ink and thread colours, the mesh colours it dissolves through, and the type the quote is set in. needle: the logo's needle (public/brand/trillion-needle.svg) as drawn on the cover: its body, where the thread is tied (eye), the angle eye-to-tip points along and its length, in the drawing's own units; it turns to head the way it moves, taking about turn_ms to turn, once it moves faster than turns_above_px_per_ms. thread: how many points the thread is drawn through, how many places the needle steers through as it draws (strewn_turns), how tightly it may turn (strewn_bend, a share of the window's short side) and the area the strewn thread may lie in, as shares of the window, clear of the quote. layout: where the thread lies, as shares of the window (row, left, right) and how big the needle is drawn (at least needle_min px, else needle_share of the window's short side); the thread stops needle_back needle-lengths short of right so the needle stays in the window. A host app draws the cover's first frame (the straight thread) natively from these same rows.
label: Opening Trillion
